children: Richard William Svetkoff disclosed a 23.87% stake in Starfighters Space, Inc.’s common stock. He filed the Schedule 13D on Aug. 31, 2026, detailing how he acquired and later sold portions of his holdings. The position stems from an equity exchange tied to Starfighters Space’s combination with Starfighters International, which he owned.

Svetkoff acquired the shares through an Equity Exchange Agreement dated Sept. 9, 2022, by swapping 100% of his equity in Starfighters International, Inc. for stock in Starfighters Space, Inc. He wrote that the purpose was a “Business combination and acquisition,” and noted he later transferred 830,000 shares to his son before the company became an SEC registrant.

He also reported open-market sales since May 8, 2026, through a broker, including multiple block sales at prices ranging from about $3.96 to $10.49 per share. After these trades, he reported ownership of 13,119,179 shares, or 23.87% of the outstanding common stock as of Aug. 24, 2026.

Richard William Svetkoff is the founder of Starfighters Space, Inc. and formerly served as its Chief Executive Officer. He previously founded Starfighters International, known for operating F-104 aircraft for research, training, and aerospace support missions. Svetkoff focuses on aviation and spaceflight services, often investing in and leading companies he helps build.
